brand.description: Boutique B&B in Ghent's historic centre with renovated rooms, fireplaces, private bathrooms and free WiFi — rated 9.4 by Booking.com guests.

hosts.about:
We are Olha & Jam, and together with our team we love welcoming travellers from Belgium and around the world to our city. For us, hosting is about much more than providing a room: we want you to feel comfortable, relaxed and genuinely welcome from the moment you arrive.

We are always happy to share our favourite streets, restaurants and cafés — the places visitors might otherwise miss — while giving you the privacy to discover Ghent at your own pace. Whether you stay one night or a whole week, we hope our B&B becomes your little home in Ghent.

footer.ctaText: Two renovated rooms in the historic centre, a 9.8 location score and hosts who love their city. We would be delighted to welcome you.

rooms.name: Double Room
rooms.summary: A calm 20 m² retreat with a large double bed, its own fireplace and city views — made for couples exploring Ghent.
rooms.description:
Our Double Room pairs a large double bed and a buttoned cream headboard with soft reading lights and its own fireplace. Tall windows look out over the city, and soundproofed walls keep the evenings quiet.

The private bathroom has a walk-in shower, free toiletries, slippers and a hairdryer. A coffee machine, electric kettle, dining table and desk let you start — or plan — the day at your own pace, and there are chocolates waiting for you.

seo.title: Double Room with Fireplace in Central Ghent
seo.description: A 20 m² Double Room in Ghent's historic centre: large double bed, fireplace, city views, walk-in shower, coffee machine and free WiFi at Gent City B&B.

rooms.name: Deluxe Family Suite
rooms.summary: A spacious 30 m² suite with a double bed, a sofa bed, a dining area and a fireplace — room for the whole family.
rooms.description:
Our largest room is a light-filled 30 m² suite under high ceilings and tall windows. A double bed with a buttoned headboard sits beside a lounge with a cream corner sofa bed, a round dining table and a marble fireplace — space for families or friends travelling together.

The private bathroom has a bathtub with a hand shower, free toiletries, slippers and a hairdryer. A coffee machine, kettle and teas, a flat-screen TV and soundproofed walls make it easy to settle in, and there are chocolates waiting for every guest.

seo.title: Deluxe Family Suite for Four in Central Ghent
seo.description: A 30 m² family suite in Ghent's historic centre: double bed and sofa bed for up to four, dining area, fireplace, bathtub and free WiFi at Gent City B&B.

reviews.name: Beth
reviews.title: We had a wonderful time in Ghent and the accommodation was faultless.
reviews.text: The location was excellent, within walking distance of everything. The rooms were amazing and so clean. The shower was lovely. There was a coffee machine in the rooms. We could not fault this property.

reviews.name: Elisabeth
reviews.title: Perfect place to explore the beautiful city of Ghent
reviews.text: Very clean and brand new, central location. Bed was so comfortable and bed linen was of very good quality. Fantastic bath for two. Olha who greeted us was very helpful and nice. Thank you.

reviews.name: Farzana
reviews.title: Fantastic, unbeatable value
reviews.text: Fantastic location, 15 mins to St Baafs. Newly renovated. Comfortable bed, great shower. Friendly host. Sweets, fruit and chocolates were a special touch.

reviews.name: Angela
reviews.title: Amazing stay!
reviews.text: Very pretty and clean. Excellent location for visiting the old city center just by less than 10 mins walk. The host is also very friendly and welcoming. Would like to return if I visit Ghent again!

reviews.name: Karen
reviews.title: Great location and great room!
reviews.text: The room was spacious and very clean, tall ceilings, modern bathroom. Very responsive to questions on WhatsApp.

reviews.name: Farida
reviews.title: Luxury room — amazing location
reviews.text: Location is amazing and room was very beautiful, brand new and extremely convenient. Great price–quality ratio!

reviews.name: Sofia
reviews.text: The room was very comfortable and clean and the staff was welcoming and ready to meet our requests.

faq.question: What time are check-in and check-out?
faq.answer: Check-in is from 14:00 to 23:00, and check-out from 07:00 to 11:00.

faq.question: Is there parking near the B&B?
faq.answer: The B&B has no private parking. The nearest public car park, Parking Reep (Seminariestraat 9), is about 130 metres away, and Interparking Gent Zuid is around 350 metres away.

faq.question: Can we leave our luggage before check-in or after check-out?
faq.answer: Yes. You are always welcome to store your luggage at the property before check-in and after check-out.

faq.question: How far is the historic centre?
faq.answer: The old town is less than ten minutes away on foot, and the Castle of Gerald the Devil is a three-minute walk from our door.

faq.question: Can you provide an extra pillow or blanket for the sofa bed?
faq.answer: Of course. Let us know and we will prepare an extra pillow and blanket for the sofa bed in the Deluxe Family Suite.

faq.question: Are children welcome?
faq.answer: Children of any age are welcome. Guests aged 18 and over are charged as adults, and cots and extra beds are not available.

faq.question: Are pets allowed?
faq.answer: Unfortunately, pets are not allowed at the B&B.

faq.question: Which languages do you speak?
faq.answer: We are happy to help in English, French, Dutch and Russian.

welcome.title: Welcome to *Gent City B&B*
welcome.body:
Welcome to our charming B&B in the heart of Ghent, where comfort, character and a fantastic city-centre location come together. Set on Notarisstraat, we offer a peaceful place to stay within walking distance of Ghent's historic centre, its canals, cafés, restaurants and landmarks.

Our rooms combine a warm, welcoming atmosphere with modern comfort and thoughtful details — the personal feeling of a boutique B&B with the professionalism you expect from a quality city stay.

intro.title: Stay in the *Binnenstad*
intro.body:
Our B&B is on Notarisstraat in central Ghent, an easy walk from the historic centre, the canals and the city's best-known sights: the Graslei and Korenlei, the Castle of the Counts, St Bavo's Cathedral and the Belfry.

Restaurants, cafés, bakeries, shops and bars are all close by, so you can leave the car behind. Spend the morning among the monuments, have lunch on a terrace, take a canal cruise in the afternoon and finish with an evening walk through the illuminated old town.
